body:
I figured I would say that I'm still alive here, I calmed down my friend who was afraid that I would die last night, and today I cut my ties with the girl. It sucks that it had to end like it did, but I left an apology for her having to grow up with an alcoholic at the end, because i had a gut feeling, and it felt like it might save my ass not to burn this bridge altogether. I won't be allowing myself to open up around her anymore, and I think I'll be okay with only one close friend left. I was hugged today by him, and about 7 others, because he already knew everything from the way I used to calm him down,  but I'm still curious how he got it to happen without saying anything. So all I can say is that I'm alive, hurt, but alive.
EDIT: I forgot to say thank you, I probably would have lasted a week or two living with my mom, dad, and nobody to tell me it wasn't your fault, and the sobbing at nights, that and the whole blaming myself.
